description: A worker host only. hyvv serves the versioned /v1 attempts API and governed provisioning on its own machine; a coordinator elsewhere sends work to it.

components.role: worker host: attempts API, governed provisioning, host filesystem owner
components.why: the worker profile is exactly this element

components.role: the dispatcher that would send briefs to this host
components.why: the host runs and serves its API without a coordinator; tests and the contract suite are self-contained

components.role: front-end the coordinator may use to reach the launcher path
components.why: workers dial out to a coordinator; they never need the desktop app locally

env.name: GITLEAKS
env.note: the scan leg requires gitleaks on PATH; the lint, unit, contract, release and installer legs do not

ports: the /v1 API binds on the worker host; default posture is loopback or a dial-out coordinator route, never an open inbound port on the open internet
auth_posture: credentials stay on the host: git access for provisioning is host-side and never handed to a request; provisioning is authorized by the host-enrolled policy file, not by the caller; dispatch authorization flows from the coordinator
cannot_do: cannot dispatch, queue or accept work on its own: something else must call /v1/attempts
cannot run the coordinator, the reconciler or any verify suite
cannot prove the live Windows path: handling is unit-tested but a live Windows host has not run it
cannot enforce the parked-project refusal: the gate is a hyvv proposal (PR 1), not shipped behaviour
governed provisioning endpoints live on the pinned feat branch (PR 4 open), not on a merged mainline

refs.path: hyvv /v1/attempts and /v1/provision/* endpoints (capabilities, project, receipts, cleanup)
hyvv scripts: install.sh dry-run, build_release_assets.py, scan-secrets.sh, contract module
